pluginstrument.author: Russ Barlow
pluginstrument.description:
This simple instrument demonstrates how to check the bit fields of the autopilot_state dataref to determine the lateral, vertical , thrust, and FMC modes. To fully understand the meanings of the bit flags see:
http://www.xsquawkbox.net/xpsdk/mediawiki/Sim/cockpit/autopilot/autopilot_state
I find it is interesting to look at this to monitor what is happening while flying the sim on autopilot. There are deprecated autopilot datarefs but these are the latest and should be good in the future
